 BLUFF, Utah (KUTV) — Photos show flooding across the Four Corners as runoff moves toward Utah and raises water levels along the San Juan River.
 The Navajo Nation Department of Emergency Management issued an evacuation notice for Bluff, Montezuma Creek and Aneth, Utah, at 11:15 p.m. as officials prepared for high water levels.
 View post on X 
 A shelter was set up at Aneth Community School, 162 San Juan County Road 466 in Montezuma Creek, Utah.
 Heavy rain across the Four Corners has sent more water toward Lake Powell, the National Weather Service in Salt Lake City said. 
 View post on X 
 The lake’s level had risen more than 10 feet from its yearly low of 3,519.1 feet to 3,529.4 feet, with river flows remaining very high.
 Lake Powell’s full pool is 3,700 feet.
